learning_outcomes.text: Knows NC, CNC and CAD/CAM functions and application areas in computer-aided manufacturing.
Knows CNC machine tool types and operating principles.

Has detailed knowledge about the structure and parts of CNC machines. (Main spindle and nut systems; guideway and slide systems; automatic tool change systems (ATC); hydraulic and pneumatic systems; lubrication and cooling systems; open and closed loop control systems, angular position control, slide position control; servo motors, stepper motors and feedback; control panels and functions.)

Can program machine coordinate systems as absolute and incremental using analytical geometry knowledge. Learns and can apply all G and M codes, as well as all subprograms and cycles performed using them, during programming.
At the end of this course, can control the production process for manufacturing a workpiece with any geometry through analytical programming and preparing the machine for production.
Additionally, with this course explaining all details of CNC machines, gains preliminary knowledge about the design and production of a new CNC machine.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Computer Aided Manufacturing: NC and CNC systems, CAD/CAM system functions and application areas.
Application Areas of CNC in Industry, CNC lathe, CNC milling machine, Other CNC machine tools.
Structure and Parts of CNC Controlled Machine Tools 1: Main spindle and nut system, Guideway and slide systems,
Structure and Parts of CNC Controlled Machine Tools 2: Automatic tool change systems (ATC), Hydraulic and Pneumatic systems, Lubrication and cooling systems.
Drive and Control Systems in CNC Machines: Open loop control systems, Closed loop control systems, Controlling angular position, Controlling slide position, Servo motors, Stepper motors, Feedback.
Control Panels and Functions in CNC Machines: Fanuc control panel, Siemens control panel, Other control panels
Machine coordinates and coordinate systems: Absolute control, Incremental control.

Programming of Lathe Machines 1: Determination of dimensioning systems, Tool selection, Determination of rotational speed, G preparatory function commands and M auxiliary function commands, Cylindrical and conical turning.
Programming of Lathe Machines 2: Circular interpolation, Thread cutting, Drilling, Reaming, Cycles: Longitudinal rough turning cycle, Face turning cycle,
Programming of Lathe Machines 3: Cycles: Profile repetition cycle, Finishing (final pass) cycle, Grooving cycle, Thread cutting cycle, Stepped drilling cycle, Subprogramming

Programming of Milling Machines 1: Determining machine zero point and work coordinate system, Determining dimensioning systems, G preparatory function commands and M auxiliary function commands, Plane surface milling, Slot milling, Step milling.
Programming of Milling Machines 2: Peripheral milling, Pocket milling, drilling and reaming, Cycles: Rectangular pocket milling cycle, Circular pocket milling cycle, Return at the end of the cycle.
Programming of Milling Machines 3: Left-hand tapping cycle, Normal drilling cycle, Dwell drilling cycle, Stepped drilling cycle, Fine and normal hole enlarging cycles.
